rationale: THE APPLIER — the class that applies BOTH mixins, and the class whose bases are all in ONE file so the first-parent answer and the declares-member answer can be told apart. The measured extFAIL on dart-http's `--index` arm: `class StreamHandler extends Object with TerminatableMixin, ClosableMixin` applies TWO mixins, `onCheckForClose` is declared by the SECOND one (`ClosableMixin`), the analyzer's first-parent fallback named the FIRST (`TerminatableMixin`), and the `isExternalBase` marker ("the project does not publish this base") was REFUTED by the arbiter for every such row — 5 on dart-http, 86 on the whole-population `--index` arm. THE FIX WAS NOT IN THE ANALYZER: the analyzer's Pass 2 already walks the heritage graph for a base that declares the member; it was never REACHED because the with-clause's mixin NAMES were not in the project index at all (Dart's `mixin_declaration` has no `name` field, so the index read "" for every mixin). The fix is one `nameResolver` on the dart index spec. THESE PINS ARE THE FLAT-FILE HALF: they run WITHOUT an index, so they pin the no-index arm's shape — the first-parent GUESS at 0.8, carrying a claim about the RUN. The indexed arm (where the base is CHOSEN at 0.95 with no external claim) is pinned by `script/m14/dart-override-mixin-base-check.ts`, because the flat runner gives dart no project index.

expectRelationships.note: THE WITH-CLAUSE, first mixin — the base the first-parent fallback would name.
THE WITH-CLAUSE, second mixin — the base that actually DECLARES `onCheckForClose` and `onClosing`.

THE NO-INDEX ARM'S ANSWER — a GUESS. Without an index the run cannot see that `ClosableMixin` declares the member, so it names the first mixin at 0.8 and marks the row as a claim about the RUN (`baseBeyondRunScope`), never as a resolution. This row is CORRECT for this arm and WRONG for the indexed arm; the indexed arm's answer is pinned by `script/m14/dart-override-mixin-base-check.ts`. The pin is here so that the no-index arm's shape is not silently changed by a fix meant for the other one.
THE CONTROL, on the no-index arm: a member the FIRST mixin declares keeps that mixin, so a fix that moved every row would fail here.
